item.title: UK manufacturers unprepared for EU DPP rules, new research finds
item.description: Retail Jeweller UK manufacturers unprepared for EU DPP rules, new research finds New research has revealed that a significant proportion of UK manufacturers and wholesalers are ill prepared for the introduction of the EU’s Digital Product Passport (DPP), a regulation that will directly affect any business exporting goods into the European Union.
